insights.one_liner: Online whiteboard company with a large Amsterdam office; current roles are English-language sales jobs, and an acquisition by Bending Spoons is in the works.

culture.text: Makes an online whiteboard where teams work together on ideas, diagrams and plans, and has a large office in Amsterdam.
All 3 current jobs here are mid and senior sales roles in Amsterdam.

open.text: Not an IND recognised visa sponsor, so non-EU candidates may struggle to get a work visa.
All 3 current jobs here don't require Dutch.

growth.text: Usage of Miro's MCP for AI collaboration is growing, per the headline.

worth_knowing.text: Bending Spoons is set to acquire Miro for USD 1.355 billion by Q4 2026.
Bending Spoons raised a EUR 400 million debt add-on to fund the Miro deal.
